title: J Hampden
memorial_details: description: A tablet accompanying a headstone, footstone and kerbs on a family grave. The headstone is in the form of a scroll unfurled over a wall but has been displaced and is leaning upside down propped against the kerbs. The tablet is in the form of an independent scroll with a strut underneath and is placed near the centre of the grave. The footstone is nowy headed but the lower part is now below ground level. The bevelled kerbs are partly below ground level. The inlaid inscription are in mainly upright capital lettering.
